{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Roccia |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = I'm always on the go, collecting treasures, helping my friends, making costumes, and repairing stage props... It's a busy routine, but seeing everyone smiling makes it all worth it. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero|Pero|A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.}}'s box is more than just a treasure trove. It's my private lounge as well. It's bigger than you might think, and I've stashed all my nifty gadgets inside. Would you like a tour? Knock, knock—open up, Pero. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Our troupe never lets anyone feel left out. We accept everyone, chasing away their worries and inviting them to be a part of the performance. If you ever feel down or sad, come see us. I'd really like to see you smile. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = People say family is about helping and comforting each other. I feel safe and warm around you... So, maybe you count as family after all? |vo_02_01_title = Roccia's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something. |vo_02_02_title = Roccia's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Cleaning up the ship is always a headache. There's algae, sewage spills, and torn canvas everywhere... And of course, there's always that person who conveniently disappears when it's time to pitch in. Pft, not like a good living and performance space is important or anything. You agree, right? |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better? |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = One day, the streets of {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}} will be alive with the spirit of freedom. Until then, I want it to grow within our troupe. We'll make the sad smile, help the hopeless dream again, give courage to the fearful, and remind everyone of who we really are. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} is my best friend. She's amazing. She can detect special frequencies on objects, carry all my stuff, and even absorb good and bad feelings and inspirations. But don't worry, she won't gobble up anything harmful, dangerous, or anything that belongs to someone. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Luceanite pebbles, if not collected in time, will lose their glow and turn to dust. I used to be one of those lost pebbles, until the {{Extra Effect|Troupe of Fools|Troupe of Fools|A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."
To reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.}} came along and saved me. Now, I can help other lost souls with my own little light. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Brant]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Brant.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Brant is the greatest captain in all of Solaris. At least, that's what he insists I say. But it's true, having him around really does bring out the best in us. His passion is infectious, and his belief in freedom is like the mast that keeps us all steady. |vo_04_01_mention = Brant |vo_04_02_title = About [[Carlotta]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Leading a large family is like steering a massive ship. It requires immense effort to keep it on course. I have firsthand experience in managing a vessel, and I admire her energy and bravery in navigating this journey. |vo_04_02_mention = Carlotta |vo_04_03_title = About [[Zani]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Zani.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong... |vo_04_03_mention = Zani |vo_04_04_title = About [[Phoebe]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Phoebe.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = She's from the {{Extra Effect|Order of the Deep|Order of the Deep|The de facto ruling authority of Ragunna that manages all city matters, from municipal policies and currency to civil disputes.
The head of the Order, known as the Primus, is currently Fenrico, who claims to be the Enlightened One—the Resonator of Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator.
According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word.}}. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first {{Extra Effect|Acolyte|Acolyte|Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.}} to touch the box without getting bitten by {{Extra Effect|Pero}}. |vo_04_04_mention = Phoebe |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = There's a new show in the works, a little something we've been rehearsing. Come check it out if you have the time. Spoiler alert... It's kind of important you're there for the show to work. Why? Because you're the main character! Happy birthday! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = The show begins.
"Pero!" |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Hello, name's Roccia. Besides being the {{Extra Effect|Troupe of Fools}}' first mate, I am also a stage mechanic and an improv performer. If you ever stumble upon something interesting, I'm a really good listener. {{Extra Effect|Pero}} stores all that inspiration, and I'll spin it into a new improv act. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = All the world's a stage, and we are mere players. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}}'s tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Time for a little laugh. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch! |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = {{Extra Effect|Pero}} said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia.
